custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

Bank English Preparation.question: ১) One of my friends ___ in France.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Complete sentence: One of my friends lives in France.
- Bangla meaning: আমার এক বন্ধু ফ্রান্সে থাকে।

• One of, Any of, Each of, Either of, Neither of বাক্যের subject হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হলে verb টি singular হবে।
- অর্থাৎ, One of + plural noun + singular verb বসে।
- "One of" দ্বারা সাধারণত অনেকের মধ্যে একজনকে বোঝানো হয়।
- যেমন: One of my friends lives in France.

• কিন্তু one in + plural noun + singular verb/ plural verb বসতে পারে।
- যেমন: One in three cars break/breaks down.

• More examples:
1. One of my friends is a lawyer.
2. One of the players has scored a goal.

Bank English Preparation.question: ২) Find the correct spelling:
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• The correct spelling is - গ) Surveillance.

• Surveillance (Noun)
- English Meaning: Close observation, especially of a suspected spy or criminal.
- Bangla Meaning: সন্দেহভাজন ব্যক্তির উপর কড়ানজর; পাহারা।

• Example Sentence:
- The parking lot is kept under video surveillance.
- More banks are now installing surveillance cameras.

Source:
1. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.
2. Cambridge Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৩) "A closed meeting of a group of persons belonging to the same political party" is called-
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• "A closed meeting of a group of persons belonging to the same political party" is called- ক) Caucus

• Caucus (Noun)
- English Meaning: A closed meeting of a group of persons belonging to the same political party or faction usually to select candidates or to decide on policy.
- Bangla Meaning: রাজনৈতিক দলের সাংগঠনিক কমিটি; এই কমিটির সভা।

• Options:
খ) Ally (সমর্থনকারী; সহযোগী): A state formally cooperating with another for a military or other purpose.
গ) Bevy (সম্মিলন; সমবেত সভা): A large group of people or things of a particular kind.
ঘ) Caravan (কাফেলা): A company of travelers on a journey through desert or hostile regions.

Source: 
1. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.
2. Merriam-Webster Dictionary.
3. Oxford Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৪) The politician was convicted ___ corruption charges.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Complete sentence: The politician was convicted of corruption charges.
- Bangla meaning: রাজনীতিবিদ দুর্নীতির অভিযোগে দোষী সাব্যস্ত হয়েছিলেন।

• Convicted somebody (of something)
- English Meaning: having officially been found guilty of a crime in a law court.
- Bangla Meaning: দোষী সাব্যস্ত করা; অপরাধী বলে রায় দেওয়া।

• More examples: 
- He has twice been convicted of robbery/arson.
- Both men had been convicted of drug trafficking.

Source:
1. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.
2. Cambridge Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৫) Choose a synonym for 'Disquieting'.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• A synonym for 'Disquieting' is- ঘ) Troubling

• Disquieting (Adjective, Verb)
- English Meaning: Lack of peace or tranquility; inducing feelings of anxiety or worry.
- Bangla Meaning: অশান্তিকর; উদ্বেজক।

• Options:
ক) Ending - শেষ অংশ; উপসংহার।
খ) Soothing - শীতল; প্রশান্তিদায়ক।
গ) Settling - নিষ্পত্তি; প্রতিষ্ঠাপন।
ঘ) Troubling - যন্ত্রণাপ্রদ; কষ্টকর।

• সুতরাং, অপশনের অর্থ বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায় যে, A synonym for 'Disquieting' is- ঘ) Troubling

Source: 
1. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.
2. Merriam-Webster Dictionary.
3. English-Bangla Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৬) Many a man ___ succumbed to such temptation.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Complete sentence: Many a man has succumbed to such temptation.
- Bangla meaning: অনেকেই এই ধরণের প্রলোভনের কাছে নতি স্বীকার করেছে।

• "Many a/an" -এর পর singular countable noun এবং singular verb ব্যবহার করা হয়।
- প্রদত্ত বাক্যে "Many a" -এর পর singular noun "man" আছে, তাই singular verb "has" হবে।

• Structure: Many a/an + singular countable noun + singular verb.

• More Examples:
- Many a flower has bloomed in this garden.
- Many a woman faces hardship every day.

Source: A passage to the English Language by S M Zakir Hussain.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৭) The opposite of the word 'Penchant':
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• The opposite of the word 'Penchant': ক) Apathy

• Penchant(Noun)
- English Meaning: A strong or habitual liking for something or tendency to do something.
- Bangla Meaning: রুচি; পছন্দ; ঝোঁক;  টান; প্রবৃত্তি।

• Options:
ক) Apathy - সমবেদনা বা আগ্রহের অভাব; (কারো/কোনো কিছুর প্রতি) উদাসীনতা বা অনীহা।
খ) Affinity - তীব্র অনুরাগ; আসক্তি; আকর্ষণ; সাদৃশ্য; মিল; ঐক্য।
গ) Inclination - প্রবণতা; ঝোঁক; প্রবৃত্তি; ইচ্ছা-অভিলাষ; আকাঙ্ক্ষা।
ঘ) Desultory - উদ্দেশ্যহীন; অসংলগ্ন; এলোমেলো; বিক্ষিপ্ত।

• সুতরাং, অপশনের অর্থ বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায় যে, The opposite of the word 'Penchant': ক) Apathy

Source: 
1. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.
2. Merriam-Webster Dictionary.
3. Oxford Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৮) Which of the following is correct?
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Correct sentence: There are no lessons today.

• Grammar Rules:
• No + singular/uncountable noun + singular verb
• No + plural noun + plural verb

- অর্থাৎ, no যুক্ত sentence টির verb নির্ধারিত হয়, no -এর পরের noun টি দ্বারা।
- no -এর পরের noun টি singular হলে verb টি singular হবে, আর পরের noun টি plural হলে verb টি plural হবে।
- যেমন: There are no lessons today.
- প্রদত্ত বাক্যে no -এর পরে 'lessons' হলো plural, তাই verb টি plural (are) হবে।

• More examples:
- No student is to leave the room.
- There are no steamships.

Bank English Preparation.question:
৯) Young people are bearing the brunt of unemployment.
The underlined phrase means-
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Young people are bearing the brunt of unemployment.
- The underlined phrase means- ক) to suffer the main part

• Take/bear the brunt of 
- English Meaning: To suffer the main part or force of it; to receive the worst part of an attack, criticism, bad situation.
- Bangla Meaning: প্রধান বা মুখ্য আঘাত সহ্য করা।

Source:
1. Collins Dictionary.
2. Longman Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১০) Choose the correct sentence:
Bank English Preparation.option1: Faija is one of the candidates who was shortlisted for the job and the only one of the candidates who was hired.
Bank English Preparation.option2: Faija is one of the candidates who were shortlisted for the job and the only one of the candidates who were hired.
Bank English Preparation.option3: Faija is one of the candidates who was shortlisted for the job and the only one of the candidates who were hired.
Bank English Preparation.option4: Faija is one of the candidates who were shortlisted for the job and the only one of the candidates who was hired.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Correct sentence: ঘ) Faija is one of the candidates who were shortlisted for the job and the only one of the candidates who was hired.

• Explanation:
- "One of the candidates" → এখানে "candidates" plural noun বোঝানো হয়েছে।
- অর্থাৎ, অনেক candidate -কে shortlisted করা হয়েছে তার মধ্যে Faija একজন।
- তাই Relative pronoun 'who' -এর antecedent "candidates" plural হওয়ায় plural verb "were" হবে।

• অন্যদিকে,
- "the only one of the candidates" -এর পরে "who was hired" সঠিক।
- কারণ, সে হলো একমাত্র candidate যাকে hire করা হয়েছে।
- তাই verb singular টি হবে।

• Grammatical Rules:
1. Sub + verb + one of + plural noun/pronoun + who/that + plural verb.
2. Sub + verb + the only one of + plural noun/pronoun + who/that + singular verb.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১১) All of them were debarred ___ entering the country for five years.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Complete sentence: All of them were debarred from entering the country for five years.
- Bangla meaning: তাদের সকলেরই পাঁচ বছরের জন্য দেশে প্রবেশ নিষিদ্ধ করা হয়েছিল।

• debar someone from something/doing something
- English Meaning: to stop someone from doing something by law or by official agreement
- Bangla Meaning: নিবারিত করা; বাইরে রাখা; আইনের সাহায্যে কাউকে কোনো অধিকার থেকে বঞ্চিত করা কিংবা কিছু করা থেকে বিরত রাখা।

• More examples:
1. The law debars him from running for reelection.
2. He was debarred from the club for unacceptable behaviour.

Source:
1. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.
2. Cambridge Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১২) "A large unorganized group of individuals" is called-
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• "A large unorganized group of individuals" is called- গ) Horde

• Horde (noun)
- English Meaning: A large unorganized group of individuals: a teeming crowd or throng; a people or tribe of nomadic life.
- Bangla Meaning: যাযাবর উপজাতি; (সাধারণত অবজ্ঞাসূচক) দল; পাল; দঙ্গল (hordes of people).

• Other options:
ক) Ancestral (পূর্বপুরুষ সম্বন্ধীয়): Belonging to one’s ancestors.
খ) Hoard (সঞ্চিত ভাণ্ডার): A supply or fund stored up and often hidden away.
ঘ) Gentry (অভিজাত সম্প্রদায়): Upper or ruling class: aristocracy.

Source:
1. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.
2. Merriam-Webster Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৩) Find the correct spelling:
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• The correct spelling is - খ) Beneficial

• Beneficial (adjective)
- English Meaning: Resulting in good; favourable or advantageous.
- Bangla Meaning: লাভজনক; মঙ্গলজনক; হিতকর।

• Example Sentences:
- The appellant had no beneficial interest in the house.
- He hopes the new drug will prove beneficial to many people.
- They have a relationship that is beneficial to both of them.

Source:
1. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.
2. Oxford Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৪) Identify the correct sentence:
Bank English Preparation.option1: Neither Rana nor his colleagues has been finished the project.
Bank English Preparation.option2: Neither Rana nor his colleagues has finished the project.
Bank English Preparation.option3: Neither Rana nor his colleagues have finished the project.
Bank English Preparation.option4: Neither Rana nor his colleagues was finished the project.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Correct sentence: Neither Rana nor his colleagues have finished the project.

• Either ...... or, Neither….nor, Not only….but also দ্বারা যুক্ত একাধিক subject -এর ক্ষেত্রে verb টি তার নিকটতম subject অনুসারে বসে।
- অর্থাৎ, assertive sentence -এ or, nor, but also -এর পরে singular subject থাকলে singular verb এবং plural subject থাকলে plural verb বসবে।

- যেমন: Neither Rana nor his colleagues have finished the project.
- এখানে যেহেতু, শেষের অংশে his colleagues – Plural, তাই এখানে have হবে।

- Structure:
• [Either/neither] + noun + [or/nor] + singular noun + singular verb.
- Neither the salesmen nor the marketing manager is in favour of the system.

• [Either/neither] + noun + [or/nor] + plural noun + plural verb.
- Neither Jony nor his friends are going to the beach today.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৫) The soldiers ___ the villagers and seized all their weapons.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Complete sentence: The soldiers fell on the villagers and seized all their weapons.
- Bangla meaning: সৈন্যরা গ্রামবাসীদের উপর আক্রমণ চালায় এবং তাদের সমস্ত অস্ত্র জব্দ করে নেয়।

• Fall on/upon someone [phrasal verb with fall verb]
- English Meaning: To attack someone suddenly and unexpectedly; seize something enthusiastically.
- Bangla Meaning: আক্রমণ করা; ঝাঁপিয়ে পড়া।

• এছাড়া Fall on -এর আরো কয়েকটি অর্থ হলো- 
- Fall on: (of someone's eyes or gaze) be directed towards something.
- Fall on: be the responsibility of a particular person or group.

• অন্যদিকে,
ক) fall through (ব্যর্থ হওয়া) - come to nothing; fail.
খ) fall for ((কথ্য) কারো বা কিছুর মায়া বা আকর্ষণে মুগ্ধ হওয়া) - be captivated by or fall in love with someone.
গ) fall off (কোনো কিছুর উপর হতে পড়ে যাওয়া; কমে যাওয়া) - become detached and drop to the ground; decrease in number, amount, intensity, or quality.

Source:
1. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.
2. Cambridge Dictionary.
3. Oxford Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৬) A number of students ___ absent from the class today.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Complete sentence: A number of students are absent from the class today.

• Grammar Rules:
- A number of (some, several, many) + plural Noun + plural verb.
- প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্যে A Number of + plural Noun আছে, তাই এরপর plural verb হিসেবে ‘are’ বসবে।

• More examples:
• A number of boys are present in today's class.
- A number of books have been borrowed from the library.

Source:
1. A passage to the English Language by S M Zakir Hussain.
2. Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar and Composition by Chowdhury and Hossain.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৭) What does the word 'Flaunting' mean?
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• The word 'Flaunting' means - গ) Display ostentatiously

• Flaunting (verb)
- English Meaning: display (something) ostentatiously, especially in order to provoke envy or admiration or to show defiance.
- Bangla Meaning: জাঁকালোভাবে প্রদর্শন করা; (আত্মতৃপ্তির সঙ্গে) জাহির করা।

• Example Sentence:
1. They accused her of flirting with the singer and flaunting herself.
2. She was criticized for flaunting herself on the beach in front of the media.

Source:
1. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.
2. Cambridge Dictionary.
3. Oxford Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৮) The invention of automatic weapons ___ endangered human life.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Complete sentence: The invention of automatic weapons has endangered human life.
- Bangla meaning: স্বয়ংক্রিয় অস্ত্র আবিষ্কার মানুষের জীবনকে বিপন্ন করে তুলেছে।

• Subject -এর সাথে preposition দিয়ে যে শব্দ বা শব্দসমষ্টি যুক্ত থাকে তারা কখনোই verb -এর উপর কোনো প্রভাব ফেলে না।
- তাই সাধারণত preposition -এর পূর্বের subject অনুসারে বসে।
- অর্থাৎ, preposition -এর পূর্বের subject টি plural হলে verb টি plural হবে এবং subject টি singular হলে verb টি singular হবে।
- কিন্তু একই sentence -এ একাধিক noun -এর পূর্বে একাধিক preposition ব্যবহৃত হলে প্রথম preposition -এর পূর্বে ব্যবহৃত noun অনুযায়ী verb বসবে।
- অর্থাৎ, sentence -এর headword টি অনুযায়ী verb ব্যবহৃত হবে।

- উল্লিখিত বাক্যে headword -The invention হলো singular, তাই verb টি singular- has হবে।

Bank English Preparation.question:
১৯) After winning the award, she became full of herself.
What does "full of herself" imply in this context?
Bank English Preparation.option2: She became overly proud and arrogant.
Bank English Preparation.option3: She became more humble and kind.
Bank English Preparation.option4: She became more helpful to others.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• After winning the award, she became full of herself.
- Here, "full of herself" implies - খ) She became overly proud and arrogant

• full of oneself/yourself
- English Meaning: overly proud and arrogant.; very self-satisfied and with an exaggerated sense of self-worth; very proud or conceited.
- Bangla Meaning: খুবই আত্মাভিমানী; নিজের সম্পর্কে উচ্চ ধারণা থাকা।

• More examples:
- With her looks I thought she'd be full of herself, but she really isn't.
- He's a bit too full of himself for my liking.
- He was too full of himself to care about anyone else.

Source:
1. Collins Dictionary.
2. Cambridge Dictionary.
3. Merriam-Webster Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ২০) Identify the sentence with the appropriate subject-verb agreement.
Bank English Preparation.option1: The CEO together with the managers is attending the conference.
Bank English Preparation.option2: The CEO together with the managers are attending the conference.
Bank English Preparation.option3: The CEO together with the managers have been attending the conference.
Bank English Preparation.option4: The CEO together with the managers were attending the conference.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Correct sentence: The CEO together with the managers is attending the conference.

• With, together with, along with, as well as, in addition to, accompanied with/by, and not, including, excluding, but, except ইত্যাদি দ্বারা কোনো noun বা pronoun যুক্ত হলে, verb টি সর্বদা প্রথম subject (noun/ pronoun) অনুযায়ী হবে।
- অর্থাৎ, প্রথম noun/ pronoun টি singular হলে verb টি singular হবে।
- আবার প্রথম noun/pronoun টি plural হলে verb টি plural হবে।

• যেমন: The CEO together with the managers is attending the conference.
- এখানে প্রথম subject - The CEO হচ্ছে singular, তাই verb টিও singular (is) হবে।

Source: Advanced Learner's English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.
